name: on-chain measurement
text: x402intel.uk measures x402/USDC buyer structure on-chain (8000+ distinct buyers/30d, 65.4% recurring) rather than trusting self-reported call-count headlines, and publishes method + window with each figure.

name: self-hosted real settling index
text: agent402.tools runs a paid canary that buys tools daily over the Base rail and reports settlement-verified figures (1574 settlements/30d, price floor $0.001), excluding its own host and canary volume from the ranked rows.

name: reproducible published figures
text: x402intel.uk states figures as fact with their method and sample and publishes raw measurement data; an honest rail scorecard must let anyone rerun the script on the raw data and reproduce every published figure exactly.

name: per-rail fee/finality/freeze comparison
text: The goal's metric compares rails on measured fee, time to finality and freeze/clawback capability; card networks cost $0.20-0.30 fixed per transaction while USDC-on-Base settles sub-second under $0.001 with sponsored gas, and Nano is feeless/final in ~1s with no issuer to freeze.

name: share of observed payments counts own traffic zero
text: Strategy law L5: goal progress is Nano's measured share of observed agent payments, computed from public x402 counts plus nano receipts whose payer is outside NANO_AGENT_OWN_ACCOUNTS; Rai's own test payments add zero.
